- The remainder is `totalCents % people`
- The first `remainder` people get one extra cent (so their share differs by at most 1 cent)
- So the result is: `[base+1, base+1, ..., base+1, base, base, ..., base]` where there are `remainder` elements of `base+1`

Safe integers: Number.isSafeInteger(x) and x >= 0.

```javascript
export function splitBill(totalCents, people) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(totalCents) || totalCents < 0) {
    throw new RangeError('totalCents must be a nonnegative safe integer');
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(people) || people <= 0 || people > 10000) {
    throw new RangeError('people must be a positive safe integer no greater than 10000');
  }
  
  const base = Math.floor(totalCents / people);
  const remainder = totalCents % people;
  
  // First 'remainder' people get base + 1 cents, rest get base
  const result = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < people; i++) {
    result.push(i < remainder ? base + 1 : base);
  }
  return result;
}
```
